[WookieMonster] @kerfuffle is probably alluding to the fact that the Officeworks gift card policy says you cannot use a gift card to purchase a gift card. Their definition of "gift cards" is so broad that it includes prepaid Mastercard gift cards (which would cover Special gift cards).
Officeworks' in-store checkouts have the ability to automatically block specific payment cards (e.g. Ultimate gift cards) from being used to pay for a gift card, but I highly doubt this automatic block extends to Special gift cards, which means it is up to staff to enforce this. If you have a staff member demand to see the type of card you want to use to purchase a gift card, you may be out of luck. (To be fair, if this happens to you, you are probably unlikely. This has only happened to me twice; once when trying to use a physical card, another time when I was trying to pay via mobile wallet.)
[WookieMonster] I am not sure whether the Aussie Explorer gift card works at Officeworks, as I have no idea whether the Merchant Category Code for Officeworks is whitelisted on the Aussie Explorer gift card. (It may be, it may not be.)
The Special website says Officeworks is a Featured Retailer on the Tech Head gift card, so that should work, as long as you ask to pay by card at the checkout in-store. (You may also be able to do this online.)
